verdict.rationale: stagewise lets several agent instances run in parallel, each in its own session, and handle multi-step workflows with shell access. A setting keeps the app awake while agents work, which implies agents can run unattended. The evidence shows no way to set up automations, such as scheduled, triggered, or headless background jobs; it only shows interactive chat-driven agent sessions inside the desktop IDE. Missing for 10: scheduled or event-triggered automations, headless or background execution independent of the IDE session, docs for defining and managing automations, and independent corroboration.
